sources.title: AI-Powered SQL Query Generator - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project converts natural language questions into SQL queries using the Llama 3 model through Ollama. The generated SQL is executed on a MySQL database, and the results are displayed in the terminal. The project demonstrates how a Large Language Model (LLM) can be used to understand user queries ...
